label: create-text
js: (() => { const cv=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); const bb=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const p=(x,y,buttons=1)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:bb.left+x,clientY:bb.top+y,button:0,buttons}); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',p(200,130))); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',p(420,210))); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{...p(420,210,0),buttons:0})); return true })()

label: create-rect
js: (() => { const cv=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); const bb=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const p=(x,y,buttons=1)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:bb.left+x,clientY:bb.top+y,button:0,buttons}); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',p(200,280))); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',p(360,380))); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{...p(360,380,0),buttons:0})); return true })()

label: select-text
js: (() => { const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=layer-object-row]')].find((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-object-type')==='text'); if(!row)return false; row.click(); return true })()

label: select-all
js: (() => { for (const t of [window,document]) t.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'a',code:'KeyA',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); return true })()

label: click-group
js: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=format-bar] button')].find((e)=>e.title && e.title.startsWith('组合')); if(!b||b.disabled)return false; b.click(); return true })()
